S.O. 5106(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 8.00. No. 520(E) dated 09/02/2022, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of Zirakpur-Parwanoo Section of NH-5 (Old NH-22) on the stretch of land from Km 39.960 to Km 67.550 
(Panchkula) in the district of PANCHKULA in the state of HARYANA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Tribune (English)” and 
“Punjab Kesri (Hindi)” both dated 11/02/2022 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government;

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby

NOTIFICATION 

Mumbai, the 31st October, 2022 


99.0. 5117(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section(]) of section 20A of the Railways 
Act, 1989 (24 of 1989) (hereinafter referred in as the said act), the Central Government after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which has given in the schedule annexed hereto, is required for 
execution of the Special Railway Project, namely, Nadiad-Petlad Gauge Conversion Project in District Kheda in the 
State of Gujarat, hereby declares its intention to acquired such land: 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section(]) of section 20D of the said Act: 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, Prant Officer Nadiad, 2nd floor, Jilla 
Sevasadan, Dabhan Road, Nadiad, District Kheda, in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the competent 
authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may. After 
hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any as the competent authority thinks necessary, 
by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (II) of section 20(D) of the said act 
shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

का.आ. 5103 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ .96 ( अ ) दिनांक 10 जनवरी 2022 , जो भारत के 
राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा छत्तीसगढ़ राज्य के जशपुर जिले में NH - 43 के 
कि.मी. 0.000 से कि.मी. 15.850 ( पत्थलगांव - कुनकुरी छ.ग. / झा . खण्ड ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चौड़ा करने / 
चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) 
के अधीन " हरिभूमि " और " द हितवाद " मे तारीख " 27.02.2022 " को दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 2nd November , 2022 

S.O. 5103 ( E ) . – Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways , S.O. 96 ( E ) dated 10 January 2022 , published in the Gazette of India , 
Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section ( 1 ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National 
Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( here in after referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared 
its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building 
( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of NH - 43 on the stretch of land from 
Km . 0.000 to Km 15.850 ( Pathalgaon - Kunkuri - CG / JH Border Section ) in the District of Jashpur in the 
State of Chhattisgarh . 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Haribhoomi " and " The 
Hitvada " both dated 27.02.2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


[ भाग II— खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ] 

49 

And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by 
the Competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority 
has submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government 
hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said 
Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

का.आ. 5104 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का . आ . , जो भारत के राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , 
उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के कानपुर नगर जिले में रिंग रोड के कि.मी. 0 से 
कि.मी .23.325 ( 37/17 , वेस्टकॉट बिल्डिंग , द मॉल रोड , आरबीआई बैंक के सामने , कानपुर नगर ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग 
के निर्माण ( चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध 
अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " ० ९ / ०६ / २०२२ " 
को " दैनिक जागरण " और " हिंदुस्तान टाइम्स " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 

है ; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है 
; 


अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपार्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 


NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 2nd November , 2022 

S.O. 5104 ( E ) . – Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways ,, published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section 
( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hercinafter 
referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , 
management and operation of Ring Road on the stretch of land from Km Oto Km 23.325 ( 37/17 , Westcott 
Building , The Mall Road , Opposite RBI Bank , Kanpur Nagar ) in the district of KANPUR NAGAR in the 
state of UTTAR PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “ Dainik Jagaran ” and 
“ Hindustan Times " both dated 09/06/2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by 
the competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority 
has submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


[ भाग II— खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ] 

And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government 
hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said 
Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd November, 2022 


S.O. 50(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways,number S.O [485 (E) Dated 30.03.2022 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 
3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening / four - laning,etc.) Maintenance, management 
and operation of Construction of ROB at Km 230.600 in lieu of level crossing No.52 and at Km 23.700 in lieu of 
level crossing No.3 in National Highway २०.65 in the district of KRISHNA in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Andhra Jyothi(Teluguy’ and “The 
Hindu (English) both dated 05.04.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

S.O. 5(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (4i) issued under sub- 
section () of section 3A of the National Highway Act, l956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH67 on the stretch 
of land under Package- from Badvel-Nellore from CH:630.960Km to CH 642.9l6Km ( Old Chainage 
628.50Km to 629.050Km and 0.000Km to .78Km) in the district of Y .S . R .(Kadapa) in the state of 
Andhra Pradesh.

both dated 8.0.2022;under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 
And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the competent 
Authority; 
And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 
Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers conferred by 
the sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land specified in the 
said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 
And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares 
that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

नई दिल्ली , 2 नवम्बर , 2022 

का.आ. 5112 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. , जो भारत के राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , 
उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के कानपुर देहात जिले में रिंग रोड के कि.मी. 0 से 
कि.मी. 23.325 ( कलक्टरेट , माटी , अकबरपुर , कानपुर देहात ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चौड़ाकरने / चार लेन का 
बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन 
करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख ० ९ / ०६ / २०२२ " 
को " हिंदुस्तान " और " द टाइम्स ऑफ़ इण्डिया " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर 
दिया है ; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 2nd November , 2022 

S.O. 5112 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub- section ( ii ) issued under sub 
section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of Ring Road on the 
stretch of land from Km . 0 to Km . 23.325 ( Collectorate , Mati , Akbarpur , Kanpur Dehat ) in the district of KANPUR 

DEHAT in the state of UTTAR PRADESH . 


26 


[ PART II - SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Hindustan " and " The Times of 
India " both dated 09/06/2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग-2, खंड-3, उपखंड (ii), संख्या 3389, तारीख 29th जुलाई2022 में प्राकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


है; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ॒ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केंन्द्रीय सरकार को 
अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए; 


और AT HALT सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में, यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि, सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त हो कर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केंन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd November, 2022 


5.0. 5102(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways number $.0.3554 (E) dated the 29th July, 2022 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, 
Section 3, Sub-Section (ii) vide No 3389 dt. 29th July 2022, issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its 
intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening / four — 
six laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of National Highway No.516F on the stretch of land from 
Km. 0 to Km. 12.250 (Samalkot to Achampeta Junction,) in the district of Kakinada earlier EAST GODAVARI in the 
state of ANDHRA PRADESH. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Times of India” (English) and 
“Praja Sakthi” (Telugu) both dated 15.08.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent authority. 


[भाग --खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 13 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government. 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 5113 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का . आ . जो भारत के राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , 
उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के एसपीएसआर नेल्लोर जिले में NH67 , पैकेज 2 , के 
कि.मी. 706.119 से कि.मी. 739.091 ( पुरानी चैनेज कि.मी. 77.5 to कि.मी. 107.155 ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के 
निर्माण ( चौड़ा - करने / चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध 
अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी

को " आंध्र ज्योति " और " प्रजाशक्ति : " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 2nd November , 2022 

S.O. 5113 ( E ) . – Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part 11 , Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub 
section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of NH67 under 
Package - 2 from Badvel Nellore from 706.119 Km . to 739.091 Km . ( old Chaiange from 77.5 Km . to 
107.155Km . ) in the district of SPSR Nellore in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH . 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “ Hans india ” and “ Andhra Jhoti ” 
both dated 09.03.2022 , under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


[ भाग II— खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ] 

43 

Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .
